finding: Generator and link-checker execFileSync Git helpers omit maxBuffer; Node default1MiB can prevent complete index listing after evidence grows. Root observed ENOBUFS; this reviewer independently confirmed both responsible call sites and existing32MiB archive-validator precedent.
recommended_change: Explicit finite32MiB maxBuffer in both existing helpers. Keep complete stdout, immutable index/blob reads, environment filtering and failures. No truncation, exclusion, catch-and-continue, or unbounded buffer.
regression_design: Use real isolated Git repository fixture, seed sufficient non-Markdown index records referencing existing blob to produce measured ls-tree output greater than1MiB.
Separately require generator write/check and link checker success on valid large fixture.
Then add unclassified Markdown sorting after padding; require exact path admission failures from both scripts, proving tail entries still processed.
Run existing doc suite unchanged to preserve environment, blob custody, symlink, missing-record and archive rejection controls.
limits: 32MiB finite ceiling remains fail-closed; no scalability claim beyond measured fixture.
No application, security or production behavior change.
Staged evidence import still requires separate exact-tree review.

assessment: 6000 real index entries reference a real blob; measured listing exceeds1MiB and all padding entries are counted.
Each consumer is tested independently; generator also covers write and regenerated check.
Tail Markdown is physically present and staged and must trigger exact missing-record rejection after large listing; malformed or absent path errors cannot satisfy the oracle.
RED failures occur in actual consumers at buffer/custody boundary; tail checks are currently blocked by intended earlier RED.
Existing assertions unchanged; added fixture requires no services or mock implementations.
